component.name: bootc Image Updates
component.summary: Manage bootc image updates and rollbacks from Cockpit

description.p: Provides a Cockpit interface for managing bootc-based system image updates and rollbacks. Shows current, staged, and rollback image information and allows triggering updates and rollbacks without using the command line.

ul.li: Turning automatic updates off now survives a reboot (the timer is masked)
The module only appears on systems booted from a bootc image
The RPM ships the minified production bundle again
Registry errors are shown in one sentence, with the raw output under Details
